1. **@MBxxvv** (31 likes)  
   Straightforward launch announcement highlighting the new self-custodial wallet that gives AI agents their own on-chain wallets to execute blockchain actions independently.[[1]](https://x.com/MBxxvv/status/2085604008413315534)

2. **@NiftyNoon** (33 likes)  
   Newsletter post linking to deeper coverage of the Agent Wallet rollout.[[2]](https://x.com/NiftyNoon/status/2085755366030102814)

3. **@Crypto__Goku** (26 likes)

4. **@whitee_rhinoo** (15 likes)  
   News roundup that includes the Agent Wallet launch among top crypto stories of the day.[[4]](https://x.com/whitee_rhinoo/status/2085745957518315869)

5. **@Cryptoemperor06** (7 likes)  
   Early post emphasizing self-custodial control for AI agents with predefined limits, marking the shift of AI wallets from concept to real infrastructure.[[5]](https://x.com/Cryptoemperor06/status/2085533036821512222)

These stand out for likes/views and how well they capture the key features (spend caps, allowlists, $10K/mo loss coverage, modes, etc.). Discussions are mostly positive and focused on the security model for agentic finance.
